title: lgr: A fully featured logging framework for R
text: Older lgr versions supported two separate, undocumented config dialects: Logger:-prefixed single-logger shorthand, hidden multi-logger logging_config dialect using implicit ClassName: keys (e.g. appenders: { AppenderConsole: { threshold: info } }). replaced single schema described . migrate: Drop top-level Logger: key; put settings directly loggers: { root: { ... } } (named logger) mapping instead.
